pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches exhibiting moderate edge angularity with subtle softening of pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch surface area is heterogeneous, with larger, vertically elongated regions on the neck transitioning to smaller, more isotropic geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological network of light-colored pathways with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-body, maintaining a distinct separation between dark patches without significant fragmentation.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck and shoulder, consistent with the profile of a short, dense mane.
